criterion: which domain of assistant functionality the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Alarms
categories.definition: Setting, querying, modifying, or canceling time-based alerts intended to wake the user or signal a specific time.

categories.name: Reminders
categories.definition: Creating, querying, modifying, or deleting tasks or notifications intended to remind the user to perform a specific action.

categories.name: Timers
categories.definition: Starting, stopping, adjusting, or querying countdown timers that track the passage of time.

categories.name: Messaging
categories.definition: Sending, reading, or managing text or video messages to contacts or groups.

categories.name: Calling
categories.definition: Initiating, managing, or ending voice or video calls with contacts.

categories.name: Music
categories.definition: Playing, controlling playback of, or querying information about songs, albums, artists, or radio stations.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Querying current conditions, forecasts, or specific weather attributes like temperature or precipitation.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Requesting news updates, headlines, or specific information regarding current events.

categories.name: Events
categories.definition: Finding, querying, or managing attendance for local events, concerts, or festivals.

categories.name: Recipes
categories.definition: Finding recipes or querying cooking instructions, ingredients, temperatures, or techniques.

categories.name: Nutrition
categories.definition: Querying nutritional information such as calories or nutrient content in food items.

categories.name: Contacts
categories.definition: Querying information about contacts, such as where they live, where they work, or their relationships to the user.
